app.name: WC04 Camera (USB experimental)
app.short_description: Refresh camera source on the menu
app.long_description: PRIVATE LOCAL TEST: font redistribution rights unverified. 0.3.5 replaces Camera Check with Refresh camera source: an animated loading circle stays on the menu, followed by a descriptor result and viewfinder shortcut. B cancels after pending USB work returns; HOME safely waits before exiting. Capture and negotiation retain the tested 0.3.4 behavior. Experimental generic UVC 1.0 MJPEG discovery; 0.3.4 physically captured photos and silent video at both sizes on 0c45:6366; this UI update awaits physical testing. One active configuration, 320x240/640x480 and interval-1 isochronous IN only. Newer UVC versions, bulk, YUYV, audio and proprietary cameras are unsupported. IOS58 and writable SD required to save. A opens live view; 1 changes size; 2 refreshes camera source; + selects Photo/Video; left/right selects Off/3/5/10 second timer. Photo: A captures, B cancels countdown or returns to menu. Video: A starts/stops silent sampled MJPEG AVI, max 60 seconds/128 MiB. HOME finalizes and exits. Host-tested and compiled, this USB experiment awaits physical Wii testing. If USB stopping waits, unplug camera. Temporary icon: Giuseppe Ramos / Vecteezy.com; see included licenses.
